purpose: Create a manual harvest queue for the two highest-fit source-universe lanes so the candidate pool expands before strict eligibility gating is asked to find application-ready scholarships.
rules: Harvesting creates candidate source leads, not applicant eligibility.
Official, sponsor, professional-body, and law-firm source pages are preferred over aggregators.
Aggregator results may discover leads but cannot prove current eligibility.
No harvested candidate source becomes application-ready until the source is verified and strict eligibility gating runs downstream.
Do not store private FAFSA, tax, SSN, income, or full personal-statement material in the public repository.

lanes.name: Legal / paralegal professional bodies
lanes.purpose: Harvest paralegal, legal assistant, bar-adjacent, certification-body, and professional-association sources that may offer scholarships, awards, CLE funding, or certification-support funds.

query_tasks.query: state paralegal association scholarship professional development
required_verification_steps: Open the sponsor or professional-body page.
Confirm current application cycle, deadline, membership requirement, eligible expense type, and required documents.
Record only public-safe summary facts before watchlist insertion.
notes: Broad state-association query for professional development scholarships.

query_tasks.query: Florida paralegal association scholarship professional development member good standing
required_verification_steps: Open the Florida sponsor page.
Confirm whether new members may apply in the same cycle or must wait for good-standing history.
Separate eligibility from narrative fit.

query_tasks.query: county paralegal association scholarship Florida certification exam CLE
required_verification_steps: Confirm sponsor geography and membership rules.
Confirm whether certification exams, CLE, or professional dues are eligible expenses.
Record deadline and source URL only after sponsor page is opened.
notes: Targets local/county paralegal groups beyond current known sources.

query_tasks.query: paralegal certification scholarship CP exam NALA affiliate
required_verification_steps: Open the affiliate or certification-body page.
Confirm certification cost coverage and applicant type.
Do not infer NALA CP eligibility from job title alone.
notes: Targets certification-support routes rather than degree-only aid.

query_tasks.query: PCCE PACE scholarship paralegal association award application deadline
required_verification_steps: Check whether the current cycle is open or expired.
Classify expired current-cycle pages as pattern_archive or watch_next_cycle, not application-ready.
Record membership blocker if present.
notes: Captures NFPA-style certification support while preventing expired-cycle reuse.

query_tasks.query: legal assistant association scholarship professional development continuing education
required_verification_steps: Confirm that paralegal/legal assistant applicants are included.
Confirm current deadline and eligible education expenses.
Record whether membership is required before application.

query_tasks.query: bar association paralegal scholarship legal assistant Florida
required_verification_steps: Open bar-association or foundation page.
Confirm whether non-attorney legal staff or legal studies students are eligible.
Mark attorney-only scholarships as rejected for User #1.

query_tasks.query: legal studies paralegal certificate scholarship adult learner professional association
required_verification_steps: Find the sponsor page behind any database result.
Confirm whether legal studies or paralegal certificate paths qualify.
Keep database pages as discovery leads until sponsor verification.
notes: Bridges legal studies and professional association language.

query_tasks.query: paralegal association scholarship application member in good standing deadline
required_verification_steps: Confirm good-standing requirement.
Confirm whether applicants can join before applying.
If membership duration is required, send eligibility inquiry instead of application packet.
notes: Designed to expose the exact blocker that stopped prior candidates.

guardrails: Membership requirements are hard blockers until observed.
Professional fit does not equal application readiness.
Expired pages can train timing and pattern recognition only.
notes: This lane is first because User #1's strongest evidence is legal-office progression and legal studies.
The target is to create many NEEDS_VERIFICATION records, not fake APPLICATION_READY results.

lanes.name: Law-firm scholarship programs
lanes.purpose: Harvest law-firm-sponsored scholarships whose eligibility may include legal studies, paralegal education, nontraditional undergraduates, adult learners, or community-service narratives.

query_tasks.query: law firm paralegal scholarship 2026 legal studies student
required_verification_steps: Open the law-firm scholarship page.
Confirm citizenship, enrollment, transcript, essay, and deadline requirements.
Do not infer that Legal Studies is a paralegal education program unless the sponsor permits it.

query_tasks.query: Florida law firm scholarship legal studies undergraduate adult student
required_verification_steps: Confirm Florida residency, school location, or U.S. citizenship rules.
Confirm whether part-time enrollment is allowed.
Record hard blockers before ranking.
notes: Tests Florida law-firm scholarships beyond paralegal naming.

query_tasks.query: personal injury law firm paralegal scholarship application deadline transcript essay
required_verification_steps: Open sponsor page and confirm current cycle.
Check if the scholarship is open to paralegal or legal studies applicants.
Record essay prompt and transcript requirement.
notes: Law-firm scholarships often use essay/transcript filters.

query_tasks.query: legal assistant scholarship law firm undergraduate legal studies
required_verification_steps: Verify whether legal assistant experience is relevant or irrelevant to eligibility.
Confirm current deadline and application form.
Separate legal-office story fit from hard eligibility.
notes: Uses User #1's legal assistant history as a search angle, not an eligibility assumption.

query_tasks.query: community service legal studies scholarship law firm adult learner
required_verification_steps: Open sponsor page and confirm whether nontraditional/adult applicants qualify.
Confirm whether community-service narrative is requested or useful.
Keep financial-need assumptions UNKNOWN unless the source requires documentation and User #1 evidence exists.
notes: Targets the hula/community-service/conflict-prevention narrative without assuming financial need.

query_tasks.query: paralegal education scholarship law firm official rules 2026
required_verification_steps: Find official rules or sponsor page.
Confirm exact education-program language.
Send eligibility inquiry if Legal Studies vs paralegal program is ambiguous.
notes: Designed to avoid repeating Buckfire-style program ambiguity.

guardrails: Law-firm scholarship pages can be real sources, but every applicant requirement still needs official verification.
Do not treat marketing language as eligibility language.
When program wording is ambiguous, output inquiry, not application.
notes: This lane is second because it is university-independent and often essay-driven.
The goal is to widen the market before asking the strict gate for application-ready results.
